card.name: Broken symbol bytes after trademark or dash
card.fires_on: The first piece of a multi-byte special character that got split apart, such as a trademark sign, an en dash between numbers, or a multiplication sign. It follows a product name or a number.

modes.label: Trademark sign after product name
modes.description: A split-up trademark or registered symbol right after a brand name.

modes.label: Dash or times sign in numbers
modes.description: A broken symbol between numbers in a range or a product.

modes.label: Non-Latin script characters
modes.description: A split byte inside Lao or Japanese text.
